title: bd report --json: one leaderboard.json from the scored cells

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: bd report --json builds one leaderboard.json

Scenario: Scored cells collapse into a single machine-readable leaderboard
  Given scored cells already committed under studies/ for one or more engines
  When I run bd report --json
  Then it writes one leaderboard.json containing every scored cell's engine, task, dimension, signed shift, interval and verdict, matching the studies/ records byte for byte

right_now_summary: bd report --json is being built to combine scored cells into one byte-accurate leaderboard.json.
